customManagers.description: Track vendored libraries that THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md records by release.
Track the cwrap release that CI and the Linux image install.

packageRules.description: A vendored release needs its sources replaced by hand, so its update is a reminder, never merged as is.
prBodyNotes: This updates only the release recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. Before merging, replace the vendored sources under `vendor/` with that release, and update the commit recorded next to it.

packageRules.description: tree-sitter and its grammars have a script that replaces their sources.
prBodyNotes: For tree-sitter and its grammars, `vendor/tree-sitter.py sync {{{depName}}}` replaces the sources and records the commit. It also prints the upstream changes to the query files, to port to `libs/markup/queries/`. The Vendored tree-sitter job fails until the sources match the release.
